tools.name: score_face
tools.description: Returns descriptive face-shape context, five subjective appearance scores, and an approximate Golden Ratio phi score for one authorized adult photo.

tools.name: analyze_face_shape
tools.description: Returns face shape, runner-up shape, outline cues, and styling direction.

tools.name: rate_jawline
tools.description: Returns visible jawline definition, balance, and lower-face cues.

tools.name: analyze_canthal_tilt
tools.description: Returns left, right, and average visible eye-corner tilt cues.

tools.name: detect_eye_shape
tools.description: Returns opening shape, corner orientation, and visible eye framing.

tools.name: analyze_adult_face_age_cues
tools.description: Returns broad adult presentation cues, not an exact age prediction.

tools.name: analyze_facial_symmetry
tools.description: Returns photo-specific left-right symmetry cues across visible features.

tools.name: analyze_golden_ratio_face
tools.description: Returns an approximate visible Golden Ratio phi score and proportion cues.

tools.name: run_attractiveness_test
tools.description: Returns a photo-specific subjective appearance score and visible basis.

tools.name: analyze_psl_score
tools.description: Returns a broad PSL-style range from visible geometry without false precision.

tools.name: calculate_facial_ratios
tools.description: Returns visible face-ratio and spacing cues from one photo.

tools.name: analyze_color_palette
tools.description: Returns style-oriented palette, contrast, and lighting cues.

tools.name: analyze_skin_appearance
tools.description: Returns appearance-only texture, evenness, shine, and lighting cues.

tools.name: find_hairstyle_direction
tools.description: Returns face-shape-based hairstyle and framing direction.
